panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (a, b, c). a: Composite panel of pediatric pelvic/proximal femoral radiographs in a 2-year-old female with bilateral developmental coxa vara; caption identifies the target disease and postoperative radiological results. [raw subtype: bilateral] b: Composite panel of pediatric pelvic/proximal femoral radiographs in a 4-year-old male with bilateral developmental coxa vara; caption identifies the target disease and postoperative radiological results. [raw subtype: bilateral] c: Composite panel of pediatric pelvic/proximal femoral radiographs in a 6-year-old male with unilateral atypical developmental coxa vara; caption explicitly identifies the disease and notes premature proximal femoral epiphyseal closure. [raw subtype: unilateral atypical]
